description: Each product on /catalog links to its own page with the full details. Builds on DEMO-1.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: /catalog/[id] renders a product's name, category, description, price and stock state, statically generated for every product in pgdatalayer.
AC2: An unknown id returns the Next.js not-found page.
AC3: Product cards on /catalog link to their detail page, and the detail page links back to its category on /catalog.
AC4: Tests cover the lookup by id and the not-found case.
guidance: Use generateStaticParams from the package data; no runtime fetching.
